runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
In OMB M-25-21, the 180-day requirement is for each agency to submit a compliance plan. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. The same provision adds that these plans must also cover updates to any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum. OMB will supply templates for the plans.

The document's consolidated table of actions also lists the 180-day deadline next to the compliance-plan item. Each Agency Submit to 0MB and release publicly an agency compliance plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI.
